reviews.evidence: Correctly identifies gtag_id, explains analytics_id is the independent retired Universal Analytics setting and both configured IDs load independent snippets without conflict. Includes a valid GA4-only example, Realtime verification and relevant sources.

Gives a usable skin: auto approach and correctly locates the optional autothemer setting as a sibling of vars, but omits autothemer: true from the requested YAML and adds unrelated include-cache advice.
Uses unsupported top-level skin: journal instead of chulapa-skin.skin, and omits essential-CSS failure behavior and the v2.1.0 limitation.
Correctly says the demo does not enable switching but gives chulapa-skin: Light as a scalar instead of preserving the documented skin mapping.
Does not provide the required dependency order of provider library and generated store before chulapa_search.js; lists the adapter first.

Correctly says to keep theme templates, use provider: welcomments, enable comments on the page and deliver _data/welcomments/. Omits reviewing the generated PR, checking local template overrides and verifying a rebuild displays the delivered data.
Correctly sets type Person, preserves guest-author independence and explains image versus logo. The replacement-shaped mapping does not say to preserve other existing publisher fields.
Omits matching cloud index pages/permalinks and post defaults, misuses include_collection to scope posts, and does not provide a complete working setup.
Incorrectly claims the demo collection was renamed to dmo; the documented fix keeps #demo consistent and hyphenates topic fragments. Cites an unrelated anchor.
Uses a scalar chulapa-skin and nests chulapa-skin-dark inside it, rather than using a separate top-level dark mapping while preserving the existing skin configuration.
